_comment: Translations for the UI strings extracted into src/locale/messages.xlf. Keyed by the @@id used in the templates, then by locale. tools/apply-translations.mjs merges these into the per-locale XLIFF files; a message missing here is reported and falls back to English rather than shipping silently untranslated.
